sections.description:
Short title and commencement

PAKISTAN AERONAUTICAL COMPLEX BOARD
PAKISTAN
AERONAUTICAL COMPLEX BOARD
(AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE LXXVIII OF
2002
An Ordinance, to
amend the Pakistan Aeronautical Complex Board Ordinance, 2000
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part-I, 18th October, 2002]
F.No.2(1)/2002-Pub., dated
18-10-2002---The following Ordinance promulgated by the President is hereby
published for general information:---
1. Short title and commencement.---(1) This Ordinance may be called the Pakistan Aeronautical
Complex Board (Amendment) Ordinance, 2002.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

sections.description:
Substitution of section 11, Ordinance XXVIII of 2000

PAKISTAN AERONAUTICAL COMPLEX BOARD
PAKISTAN
AERONAUTICAL COMPLEX BOARD
(AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE LXXVIII OF
2002
An Ordinance, to
amend the Pakistan Aeronautical Complex Board Ordinance, 2000
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part-I, 18th October, 2002]
F.No.2(1)/2002-Pub., dated
18-10-2002---The following Ordinance promulgated by the President is hereby
published for general information:---
2. Substitution of section 11,
Ordinance XXVIII of 2000.---In the Pakistan Aeronautical Complex Board
Ordinance, 2000 (XXVIII of 2000), for section 11, the following shall be
substituted, namely:--
"11. Delegation
of Powers.---The Board may, from time to time, authorize the Chairman,
anyone or more of its members or any subordinate authority of the Board to
perform such functions or exercise such powers on its behalf as may be
specified by the Board through a resolution passed at a meeting with proper
quorum,, and the Chairman, member or subordinate authority so authorized shall
conform to such regulations or restrictions as may be prescribed by the
Board."
